text:
Leah: Hey everyone — starting the Harboron onboarding thread. High-level objectives: get their support desk using Redwood chat + embeddings for knowledge retrieval, enable ops visibility in Console, and confirm renewal health indicators by day 60. Kickoff meeting scheduled Tue May 6 10:00 PT. Harboron PM (Maya) will attend.

Sam: Quick check  do we have the integration contact on their side for proxy/token setup?

Leah: Maya is the integration lead. She's copied in the calendar invite. I'll ask for a point-of-contact for SSO and network allowlists.

Priya: I'll lead model selection & evaluation. Plan: 1) ingest 30k tokens of their FAQ/support threads, 2) run a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baseline, 3) measure precision@5 and answer relevance. Target: baseline eval on day 3, baseline report by EOW.

Eddie: Ops/infra notes: we need sample traffic patterns to recommend hosted vs dedicated. If they have <2k sustained concurrent tokens, hosted with configured batching should be fine. Please share p50/p95 latency targets.

Carmen: From CS side  I'll own enablement materials and the customer-facing runbook. Suggest three checkpoints: Dev handoff (day 7), Feature acceptance (day 21), Pre-launch ops dry-run (day 28).

onboard-bot: Reminder created: Harboron Kickoff meeting  Tue May 6 10:00 PT. Recording enabled.

Sam: Risk items to log: 1) token scope misconfig during proxy setup, 2) data residency constraints (they may require EMEA-only logs), 3) slow SSO approval.

Leah: Noted. I'll add those to the risk register and tag legal for the data residency question.

Priya: Proposed quality gate for go-live: acceptance tests must pass >= 90% on the curated prompt set; regression thresholds: no more than 5% drop in top-1 accuracy vs baseline. Also require sanity checks for hallucination rate under 3% on random sample.

Carmen: Good. For enablement, proposed schedule: Week 1  Integrator workshop (code examples, token mapping), Week 2  Admin + Console walkthrough, Week 3  Customer ops runbook + failover drills. I'll publish calendar invites after kickoff.

Eddie: For tracing, send them the headers we expect to propagate:
```
X-Redwood-Request-ID
X-User-ID
X-Forwarded-For
X-Request-Latency-ms
```
I'll add an example logging snippet to the onboard doc.

Leah: Great. Also let's capture feedback via two channels: 1) short in-product pulse (after week 2), 2) a 5-minute NPS check at day 30. Draft message to Maya: "Can you nominate the SSO admin and the network allowlist owner? Also please share sample support traffic (requests/day) and any regional data constraints."

Sam: Action owners summary: Leah -> request SSO/contact + legal tag (today), Priya -> baseline eval (day 3), Eddie -> append tracing/log examples (tomorrow), Carmen -> publish enablement calendar (post-kickoff).

Priya: Uploading the eval prompt set and the initial ingestion plan to the docs repo: https://redwood.docs/harboron/onboarding/ingest (will update with results).

Leah: Success metrics (short): a) Integration demo with live queries by day 7, b) Console shows per-route token & cost breakdown, c) Acceptance tests pass per Priya's gate, d) Renewal sentiment "positive/likely" by day 60.

Carmen: I'll add a pre-emptive slide for the exec check at day 45 to surface any adoption concerns.

Sam: One more ops ask: confirm whether Harboron wants logs retained for 90d or 365d — that'll affect storage/rollup configs.

Leah: I'll ask Maya in the kickoff. If they want 365d, legal + infra will need to confirm retention/archival plan.

Eddie: Also flag rate-limit and burst settings in the onboarding doc so they can tune proxies. Example config snippet I'm adding:
```
rate_limit: 100rps
burst: 200
concurrency_limit: 10
```

Priya: :white_check_mark: baseline eval will be ready by Fri.

Leah: Follow-ups recap posted: Leah (SSO + legal) | Priya (eval) | Eddie (tracing & rate limits) | Carmen (enablement calendar). We'll reconvene after the kickoff to lock timelines.

Carmen: Thanks all  I'll post the enablement schedule and the runbook draft to the shared folder.

Leah: Thanks team. I'll ping Maya with the pre-kickoff questions and post updates here.

Sam: Looking forward to it.
